levels.surface: أبي بكر بن عبد الله بن قيس

notes: The editor's gloss «يعني العوقي» between dashes is left out; the surface is «محمد بن سنان».
The Companion is only «أبيه» (the father of Abu Bakr b. Abd Allah b. Qays), a bare relation; the Prophet is the end.
The compiler's remark after the saying («قال مصنف هذا الكتاب») is not a link.
